NAME: UNSEPARATED_P0_DELAY
MECHANISM: Pre-slide scanning consumes elapsed time under distinct 1200s threshold before slide_ready
PRESENCE_CRITERION: Timeout occurs with slide_ready absent or threshold=1200 or P0 duration cannot be separated from post-fork
ABSENCE_CRITERION: Verified P0_EXIT_SLIDE_READY event received prior to 1200s from post-fork with active threshold switched to 2200s
UNKNOWN_CRITERION: Required P0 or slide_ready event missing or supervisor state transition lost
TRIAL_CONSEQUENCE: C1_PRESENT yields INVALID and NO_VOTE; C1_UNKNOWN yields INCONCLUSIVE and NO_VOTE

NAME: ANDROID_CGROUP_FREEZER
MECHANISM: Android freezes or suspends process while CLOCK_MONOTONIC advances artificially inflating duration
PRESENCE_CRITERION: Any cgroup freeze event or kernel suspend marker detected during trial duration
ABSENCE_CRITERION: Continuous monitor active for 100% of trial duration with zero freeze events and max gap <=500ms
UNKNOWN_CRITERION: Detector coverage <100% or any monitoring gap >500ms
TRIAL_CONSEQUENCE: C2_PRESENT yields INVALID and NO_VOTE; C2_UNKNOWN yields INCONCLUSIVE and NO_VOTE

NAME: THERMAL_THROTTLING_CORE_MIGRATION
MECHANISM: Thermal governor clamps CPU frequency or migrates work inflating legitimate durations
PRESENCE_CRITERION: Thermal zone exceeds critical trip point or CPU frequency clamped below minimum valid baseline
ABSENCE_CRITERION: Continuous monitor active for 100% of trial duration remaining within declared stratum with max gap <=2500ms
UNKNOWN_CRITERION: Detector coverage <100% or any monitoring gap >2500ms
TRIAL_CONSEQUENCE: C3_PRESENT during timeout yields INVALID and NO_VOTE; C3_UNKNOWN yields INCONCLUSIVE and NO_VOTE
